scope: Taranaki Cathedral Church of St Mary at 37 Vivian Street as photographed in July 2024, with the attached Hatherly Hall and the nearby stone cross visible in the cleared exterior references.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: Heritage listing 148 confirms the Vivian Street address, the north transept, Gothic Revival lancets, and eastern five-sided sanctuary.
The cathedral identifies the original volcanic andesite, and the attached stone-walled, gabled Hatherly Hall.
Council consent text identifies the original Welsh slate and documents the southwest hall, south aisle, chancel and transept.
